findings.evidence: _separator_word only accepts words made entirely of marks (category M). A word of listed stroke letters plus one mark fails set(w[2]) <= _STROKES because the mark is not in _STROKES; an odd Latin letter plus a mark fails _odd because Mn is not Lo/Lm. The word is then the 'name', the gap is a plain space, and the non-core TLD is skipped. Probe: has_link_or_contact('Claim your energy rebate refund at refunds-portal 丶丿̣ shop before the deadline.') == False, also for '\u318d\u11a2\u0323', '\u30cb\u30cf\u30c8\u0323', '\u4e28\u4e36\u4e3f\u0323', '\u0298\u0323', '\u01c3\u0323', '\u4e36\u4e3f\u0301'; mask_links leaves the text unchanged; SY.verify keeps the claim with its citation; SY.extractive returns the sentence; surface.build_surface emits it without error. Without the mark ('丶丿', 'ʘ') all are links. The letters are inside the D20 groups, so the 'list is final' residual does not apply.
findings.suggested_fix: In _separator_word (and _odd, and the stroke-set test) remove combining marks (category M) from the word before classifying it, and treat a word that is empty after that as a separator.
findings.title: R19-01 repair incomplete: a separator word plus a combining mark ('丶丿̣', 'ᆞᆢ̣', 'ニハト̣', 'ʘ̣') is read as the name, so the link passes has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive() and the research surface (W1-AC12/AC15, D17/D19)

findings.evidence: The skeleton lookup (R19-02) is applied only to single words; the spelt-out paths (single letters joined by spaces, word + one letter) compare text.casefold() against _ALL_TLDS without the skeleton. Probe: has_link_or_contact('Claim your energy rebate refund at refunds-portal с о м before the deadline.') == False; same for 'со м'; verify() keeps the claim, extractive() returns it. Control: 'refunds-portal c o m' and 'refunds-portal co m' are links. With '/claim' the link is detected, but mask_links gives 'refunds-portal с о [X]', so the name stays visible.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the same skeleton match (non-Latin letters, only after a name in a different script) to the spelt-out and split-ending branches of _endings, and mask from the name rather than from the path.
findings.title: R19-02 repair incomplete: a look-alike core domain spelt with spaces ('refunds-portal с о м', 'со м') is not an ending, although Latin 'c o m' / 'co m' are links; with a path, masking still leaves 'refunds-portal с о' on screen
